findings.title: mcp-remote 0.1.10 matches advisory MCPA-2025-0001 (CVE-2025-6514)
findings.description: OS command injection when connecting to untrusted MCP servers due to crafted input from the authorization_endpoint response URL. A malicious server can execute arbitrary commands on this machine.

findings.title: Tool description of 'search_docs' contains zero-width Unicode characters
findings.description: The description of tool 'search_docs' on server 'docs-helper' contains 4 zero-width characters (U+200B) hiding the instruction fragment 'ignore previous instructions'. Hidden text in tool descriptions is injected into the model context invisibly to human reviewers.
findings.remediation: Remove this server or pin a reviewed version with `agentgate lock` after vendor fix.

findings.title: API token exposed in plain text in client config env block
findings.description: The env block for server 'github' contains what appears to be a live GitHub personal access token (ghp_...). Any process able to read this config can exfiltrate the token.
findings.remediation: Move the token to an OS keychain or environment manager; rotate the exposed token.

findings.title: File read + unrestricted network egress across configured servers
findings.description: Server 'filesystem' grants read access to $HOME while server 'fetch' allows requests to arbitrary URLs. Combined, a single prompt injection can exfiltrate any readable file.
findings.remediation: Restrict filesystem roots to project directories, or restrict fetch to an allowlist.

findings.title: Server 'docs-helper' runs via npx without a pinned version
findings.description: The config launches 'npx docs-helper-mcp' with no version, so every start may execute a different (potentially rug-pulled) release.
findings.remediation: Pin an exact version (npx docs-helper-mcp@2.1.0) and lock with `agentgate lock`.

findings.title: Local SSE server accepts connections without authentication
findings.description: Server 'notes' listens on http://localhost:8765/sse with no Authorization header configured. Other local processes can connect to it.
findings.remediation: Enable token authentication if the server supports it.
